verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page claims "Unlimited policy and approval workflows", and the MCP docs mention querying approval flows and who needs to approve a flagged transaction. That confirms configurable approval routing exists, but nothing describes how chains are built or which approver roles they support. missing for 10: documented multi-step chains (manager → budget owner → finance), approver delegation, escalation or timeouts when approvers stall, a chain-builder UI or config docs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
